description: Flat metadata schema for synthesized herbicide compounds characterized by NMR/MS and evaluated in vitro against plant enzymes, pathways, and species for potency, selectivity, and potential toxicity.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for the metadata record or assay observation.

compound_id.descr: Unique identifier for the synthesized herbicide compound in the dataset.

compound_name.descr: Common or project name of the compound, if assigned.

compound_smiles.descr: Canonical SMILES string representing the compound structure.

compound_inchi.descr: InChI string representing the compound structure, if available.

compound_inchikey.descr: InChIKey identifier for the compound, if available.

compound_formula.descr: Molecular formula of the compound, e.g., C15H12ClFN2O3.

compound_molecular_weight.descr: Molecular weight of the compound in g/mol.

compound_purity_percent.descr: Measured purity of the compound in percent (%), if determined.

compound_batch_id.descr: Identifier for the synthesis batch or lot.

synthesis_date.descr: Date the compound was synthesized, if recorded.

synthesis_method.descr: Brief description or code for the synthetic route used.

nmr_method.descr: NMR method used for characterization, e.g., 1H NMR, 13C NMR, 2D NMR.

nmr_solvent.descr: Solvent used for NMR analysis, e.g., CDCl3, DMSO-d6.

nmr_identity_confirmed.descr: Whether NMR data supported the proposed molecular identity.

ms_method.descr: Mass spectrometry method used for characterization, e.g., ESI-MS, LC-MS, MALDI-TOF.

ms_ion_mode.descr: MS ionization polarity, e.g., positive, negative.

ms_observed_mz.descr: Observed mass-to-charge ratio (m/z) for the principal ion.

ms_expected_mz.descr: Expected theoretical mass-to-charge ratio (m/z) for the principal ion.

ms_mass_error_ppm.descr: Mass measurement error in parts per million (ppm).

ms_identity_confirmed.descr: Whether mass spectrometry data supported the proposed molecular identity.

melting_point_c.descr: Melting point in degrees Celsius, if measured.

logp.descr: Partition coefficient logP or an equivalent hydrophobicity metric.

pka.descr: Acid dissociation constant pKa, if measured or estimated.

water_solubility_mg_ml.descr: Aqueous solubility in mg/mL, if measured.

assay_id.descr: Unique identifier for the bioactivity assay or experiment.

assay_type.descr: Assay category, e.g., enzyme inhibition, cell-based pathway assay, phytotoxicity assay.

assay_format.descr: Experimental format, e.g., in vitro, cell-free, cell-based.

target_species.descr: Plant species used in the assay or biological context, e.g., Arabidopsis thaliana.

target_tissue_or_cell_type.descr: Specific tissue, cell type, or culture type tested, if applicable.

target_enzyme_or_pathway.descr: Name of the plant enzyme or cellular pathway evaluated.

target_accession.descr: Database accession or stable identifier for the target, if available.

target_organism_taxonomy.descr: Taxonomic identifier or classification for the tested organism, if recorded.

assay_duration_h.descr: Assay incubation or exposure duration in hours.

vehicle_control.descr: Solvent or vehicle used to deliver the compound, e.g., DMSO.

vehicle_percent_vv.descr: Vehicle percentage in the assay solution, if applicable.

positive_control_compound.descr: Reference active compound used as a positive control, if any.

negative_control_description.descr: Description of the negative or vehicle control condition.

replicate_count.descr: Number of technical or biological replicates.

endpoint_name.descr: Measured biological endpoint, e.g., IC50, enzyme activity, cell viability, chlorosis score.

endpoint_value.descr: Numeric value of the measured endpoint.

endpoint_unit.descr: Unit for the endpoint value, e.g., nM, µM, % inhibition, RFU.

endpoint_lower_is_better.descr: Whether lower endpoint values indicate stronger activity or better performance.

percent_inhibition.descr: Observed percent inhibition at the stated concentration, if applicable.

percent_activation.descr: Observed percent activation at the stated concentration, if applicable.

ec50_um.descr: Half-maximal effective concentration in micromolar (µM), if calculated.

ic50_um.descr: Half-maximal inhibitory concentration in micromolar (µM), if calculated.

ki_um.descr: Inhibition constant Ki in micromolar (µM), if calculated.

max_efficacy_percent.descr: Maximum observed efficacy or inhibition percentage.

selectivity_index.descr: Selectivity metric comparing activity between target and off-target species or pathways.

off_target_name.descr: Name of an off-target enzyme, pathway, or organism used in selectivity assessment.

toxicity_metric_name.descr: Name of the toxicity or phytotoxicity endpoint measured, if applicable.

toxicity_metric_unit.descr: Unit for the toxicity measurement, if applicable.

result_interpretation.descr: Categorical interpretation of the result, e.g., active, inactive, weakly active, toxic.

measurement_notes.descr: Free-text notes on deviations, anomalies, or interpretation relevant to the measurement.

assay_date.descr: Date the assay was performed, if recorded.

operator_id.descr: Identifier for the person or instrument operator who performed the assay, if recorded.

instrument_name.descr: Name or model of the instrument used for characterization or assay readout, if relevant.

data_source_reference.descr: Source file, notebook, or publication reference for this record.
